title: [master] Renewal Term field on the Create Contract Renewal Quote page does not accept the entered value such as 12M
summary: The Renewal Term field on the Create Contract Renewal Quote page now correctly accepts and retains entered values like '12M' instead of resetting to blank when the field is exited.
key_points: Fixed OnAfterGetRecord to read from the temporary buffer first
Prevents overwriting of just-entered values with persistent record data
Only loads persistent Subscription Line when temporary buffer doesn't contain the row
Resolves issue where manual Renewal Term entries were lost on field exit
